description: Current state of the Sigstore Rekor public transparency log: total number of signing entries, the signed tree head, the Merkle root hash and every retired shard. AUTHORITATIVE for how many software signing events Sigstore has recorded and for the checkpoint a verifier needs. Use it before rekor_entry_by_index — the highest valid index is tree_size - 1. Keyless. Example: rekor_log_info({}).

stable.description: Ask for the last stable (fully replicated) checkpoint rather than the newest. Default false.

name: rekor_log_info
title: Rekor Log Info
